claim: In a multicenter retrospective series of sEEG-guided neocortical RNS depth leads (55 patients), median clinical seizure reduction was 66.7% at 1 year and 77.5% at long-term follow-up (2.35 ± 0.95 y); 18.2% achieved complete seizure freedom.

supporting_passages: A total of 87 depth leads were implanted in 55 patients across neocortical brain regions.
The median reduction in clinical seizures improved from 66.7% at 1-Y to 77.5% at long-term follow-up (LTFU: 2.35 ± 0.95 years), with 10 patients (18.2%) achieving complete seizure freedom.
At 1-Y, shorter Euclidean distance between the sEEG-EF and RNS System depth leads predicted improved seizure outcome in strong responders (β = -0.84, p = 0.008)
